description: Urban Transport Network Dataset of Oran, Algeria is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. First public release of the urban transport network dataset of Oran, Algeria, used for route planning and clustering experiments. Coverage: Algeria. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are urban transport, route planning, graph, Oran, Algeria. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
